messages:
nina (PM): kickoff: short thread to lock down Q3 onramp for regional routing + tenant isolation. need concrete launch gates we can commit to in the roadmap.
omar (Eng-Arch): idea: define three 'service profiles' (not lanes) aligned to customer contracts: strict-residency, regional-resilient, and pooled-cost. map each to placement, SLOs, and required billing model.
jin (Infra): infra constraints: strict-residency -> per-tenant placement table + egress ACLs; regional-resilient -> fast failover + warm warm-standby; pooled-cost -> global scheduler + aggressive batching.
peter (Sales): customers want contract language: "region-locked" with audit trail + a rollback SLA. also ask for a transparent $ delta for switching profiles. anchor customers: ClearBank and HealthFirst interested.
contracts-bot: reminder: include residency clause id C-RES-1 in any pilot agreements.
nina (PM): launch gates proposal (short): 1) automated residency enforcement test, 2) SLOs measured end-to-end (p95, availability), 3) pilot cutover runbook + 2 pilot successes, 4) billing reconciliation within 5%.
omar (Eng-Arch): SLO targets suggestion: strict-residency p95 <= 200ms (in-region), regional-resilient p95 <= 180ms (with failover window documented), pooled-cost p95 <= 300ms but 40% cost reduction goal. availability >= 99.9 for GA.
jin (Infra): need reserved capacity SKU for strict pilots (NVLink or dedicated pools). estimate 4 sprint work to add placement enforcement + audit logs, 2 sprints for failover plumbing, 2 sprints for billing tags and reconciliation.
peter (Sales): timeline ask: can we offer a 60-day pilot with support? customers want a clear migration story: shadow traffic for 7-14 days, then cutover with rollbacks.
nina (PM): agree. add migration metrics: latency delta, error-rate delta, and cost variance. gate GA on two pilots with stable metrics for 14 days post-cutover.
omar (Eng-Arch): product knobs: expose profile in Console + API. policy sketch: {"profile":"strict|resilient|pooled","region_pin":"<region|null>","failover":"auto|manual"} (store as tenant metadata).
jin (Infra): implementation note: derived routing keys must be stored as columns for hot-path lookups to avoid JSON parse on request.
contracts-bot: task created: draft residency addendum -> @legal (due Mon).
peter (Sales): ensure Console shows estimated monthly delta before customers sign. that prevents sticker shock.
nina (PM): prioritization: A) residency enforcement + audit logs, B) Console policy editor + profile preview, C) reserved SKU + pricing model, D) cost optimizations for pooled profile. agreed?
omar (Eng-Arch): agreed. also include an escape hatch: tenant-level override to force-fallback to resilient during incidents. need audit trail for overrides.
jin (Infra): will prototype placement enforcement and a lightweight audit sink. i'll post ETA tomorrow.
nina (PM): action items: omar -> write spec + acceptance tests (EOW). jin -> infra ETA + reserved SKU draft (Tue). peter -> lock two pilot customers and legal contacts (Mon). i'll draft GA gates and pilot pack.
peter (Sales): on it. pinging ClearBank and HealthFirst now. :rocket:
nina (PM): thanks team. scheduling follow-up sync Thu 9am.
